subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: After an accepted Gateway disconnect, should `openclaw agent` recover the original run first and then automatically use the isolated embedded fallback, or should unresolved recovery fail closed unless the user explicitly opts in to rerun?
rationale: Both paths are defensible, but they deliberately change the current user-visible CLI fallback contract, result latency, and duplicate-side-effect tradeoff; source review cannot choose that policy.

options.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
options.body: Approve wait-and-cache replay as the primary path and retain the existing fresh isolated embedded fallback only after the approved recovery deadline expires.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed recovery
options.body: Require unresolved outcomes to stop with the run identifier and make any rerun an explicit user opt-in, with matching CLI and documentation changes.

options.title: Retain current fallback behavior
options.body: Keep current-main’s immediate isolated fallback contract and pause or substantially narrow this branch.

recommendation.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Approve wait-and-cache replay as the primary path and retain the existing fresh isolated embedded fallback only after the approved recovery deadline expires.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current fresh-session fallback behavior and are the strongest history-backed routing candidate for changing its successor contract.
